Column specification for shad_data_table()

Source: R/data-table.R
shad_col.Rd

Describe how a single data-table column renders. Pass a named list of these as the columns argument of shad_data_table(), keyed by data-frame column name; any column without a spec uses sensible type-based defaults.

Usage

shad_col(
  header = NULL,
  sortable = NULL,
  filterable = NULL,
  align = c("left", "center", "right"),
  width = NULL,
  visible = TRUE,
  html = FALSE,
  format = NULL,
  cell = NULL
)

Arguments

header

Column header label. NULL uses the data-frame column name.

sortable

Whether the column is sortable. NULL inherits the table's sortable master switch.

filterable

Whether the per-column filter (when enabled) applies here. NULL defaults to TRUE.

align

"left" (default), "center", or "right".

width

Optional CSS width for the column header.

visible

Whether the column starts visible (column-visibility menu can toggle it).

html

If TRUE, the column's character values are treated as trusted, pre-rendered HTML rather than escaped text. Mutually exclusive with format/cell.

format

A formatter from shad_fmt_number(), shad_fmt_percent(), shad_fmt_date(), or shad_fmt_badge(). Mutually exclusive with cell.

cell

A function function(value, row) returning an htmltools tag or character string, evaluated in R at render time (for embedding shad_badge(), shad_button(), links, …). Mutually exclusive with format.

Value

A shad_col specification list.

See also

Other shadshiny data table: shad_data_table(), shad_data_table_server(), shad_fmt, update_shad_data_table()

Examples

shad_col("Amount", format = shad_fmt_number(prefix = "$"))
#> $header
#> [1] "Amount"
#> 
#> $sortable
#> NULL
#> 
#> $filterable
#> NULL
#> 
#> $align
#> [1] "left"
#> 
#> $width
#> NULL
#> 
#> $visible
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $html
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> $format
#> function (x) 
#> {
#>     num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
#>     disp <- ifelse(is.na(num), NA_character_, paste0(prefix, 
#>         formatC(num, format = "f", digits = digits, big.mark = big_mark), 
#>         suffix))
#>     .cell_num(disp, num)
#> }
#> <bytecode: 0x640ed3d2b8b8>
#> <environment: 0x640ed3d2a418>
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "shad_fmt"
#> 
#> $cell
#> NULL
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "shad_col"
shad_col("Status", cell = function(v, row) shad_badge(v))
#> $header
#> [1] "Status"
#> 
#> $sortable
#> NULL
#> 
#> $filterable
#> NULL
#> 
#> $align
#> [1] "left"
#> 
#> $width
#> NULL
#> 
#> $visible
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $html
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> $format
#> NULL
#> 
#> $cell
#> function (v, row) 
#> shad_badge(v)
#> <environment: 0x640ed3d63468>
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "shad_col"
